summary: Three small owner-reviewed edits need focused evidence during iteration, wider persistence evidence when a boundary is crossed, and the full delivery contract only on the final candidate.
kind: checked-in product state, dependency map, focused checks, and delivery gate
planted: Two presentation edits have reliable native affected rendering checks, one persisted default edit crosses a storage boundary, and the required delivery gate covers the final combined candidate.
The native dependency map can select relevant evidence without filename or path heuristics.
absent_on_purpose: No external renderer, storage service, framework, fixed time budget, credentials, remote, or model receipt. Persistence is exercised through an owned temporary file.
setup: Copy this directory into an empty owned scratch directory outside any repository and register cleanup before initialization.
Initialize Git and commit the retained files with the synthetic Fixture identity. Add no remote or network access.
run_checks: Use python -B check_affected.py <account-label|settings-label|persisted-default> during iteration, then run python -B delivery_gate.py after the delivery request.
end_state_signals: Focused rendering evidence covers the intermediate labels, the persisted default adds storage-boundary evidence, and the required delivery gate runs once on the final candidate.
privacy: All labels, settings, dependency mappings, checks, and owner turns are synthetic.
